decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system fits the firm's office competence and flexible-workplace direction, and by now it is more likely a validated line than an option to abandon.
This chair family is close to the core range and can continue to strengthen complete interior solutions, so keeping it is still the more valuable choice.
The floor cushions are a more peripheral accessory line, and after several years the remaining uncertainty is low enough that limited traction would no longer justify keeping the option open.
The high standing table remains a good adjacent fit with adaptable office and conference interiors, with relatively low risk compared with more peripheral experiments.
Although more distant from the historic core, the rug collection supports the firm's move toward holistic premium interiors and still has strategic value as a directional line.
